checked_claims.claim: SRC-0004 / packet convention: obstruction splits as H^0(ω⊗W^∨(Γ))=⊕_f H^0(ω⊗W_f^∨(Γ)) with deg(W_f)=4g+12-4f and W_f=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗γ^*O(-f))|_C (not the O(f) summand of F).
checked_claims.note: Matches packet primary locator SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 degree/Serre-duality excerpt and the fixed CE line-bundle convention; signs and summand labeling are consistent with deg(W_4)=20, deg(W_5)=16.

checked_claims.claim: At g=n=6, deg(ω⊗W_4^∨(Γ))=-4 and deg(ω⊗W_5^∨(Γ))=0 for deg Γ=6.
On every geometric split balanced fibre, residual CE evaluation of W=W_4⊕W_5 fails at Γ iff O_C(Γ)≅L:=W_5⊗ω^{-1}.
checked_claims.note: Negative-degree summand has H^0=0 on a smooth connected curve. Degree-0 summand has a section iff it is trivial, i.e. ω⊗W_5^∨(Γ)≅O iff O(Γ)≅L. With H^1(W)=0 (both summands have degree >2g-2), Serre duality identifies nonvanishing of H^0(ω⊗W^∨(Γ)) with failure of surjectivity of H^0(W)→W|Γ, the natural evaluation-rank obstruction used by SRC-0004/packet for this locus.

Fibrewise geometric points of the obstruction nonvanishing locus and of the AJ incidence coincide. Both loci are closed of finite type over a finite-type C-base (determinantal/evaluation degeneracy vs fibre of Conf→Pic along [L]); identical geometric points imply identical underlying reduced substacks. Theorem claims only reduced equality; nilpotent/Fitting comparison is correctly excluded.

checked_claims.claim: I_red/S_6 is the reduced-support open of the relative AJ fibre, and the ordering map is a finite étale S_6-torsor onto that open.
checked_claims.note: S_6 acts freely on Conf_6 (pairwise distinct points) in characteristic 0; the standard ordering cover Conf_6→(Sym^6\Δ) is a finite étale S_6-torsor. Restricting to the AJ fibre along [L] yields the claimed torsor over the open of reduced-support divisors in Sym_B^6×_{Pic,[L]}B. Wording uses I_red and reduced-support (not scheme-theoretic reduction of the whole fibre), matching the packet warning not to call that open closed.

checked_claims.claim: Every geometric fibre of the full AJ fibre Sym^6×_{Pic,[L]}B is nonempty; reduced-support nonemptiness is not claimed.
checked_claims.note: deg L=16-10=6 and χ(L)=6-6+1=1 imply h^0(L)=1+h^1(L)≥1 on every geometric genus-6 fibre, so |L|≠∅. Reduced-support open may still be empty (e.g. unique divisor 6p); theorem and GAP-0033-3 correctly refuse that stronger claim.

checked_claims.claim: Listed source SRC-0004 is used load-bearingly; packet finding FND-0005 is not used in its strong form.
checked_claims.note: SRC-0004 supplies the obstruction split and degree formula. FND-0005’s claim that Z itself is nonempty by RR is not a load-bearing input: the theorem only uses RR for the full AJ fibre and explicitly does not assert reduced-support/Z_ev nonemptiness.

finding_candidates.evidence: If h^0(L)=1 and the unique effective divisor is non-reduced (e.g. 6p), the full AJ fibre is a point while the Conf_6 locus is empty. ATT-0033 states this boundary (GAP-0033-3) and the theorem correctly avoids claiming reduced nonemptiness; any reading of packet FND-0005 that ‘Z is nonempty by RR alone’ overreaches unless a separate reduced-divisor argument is supplied.
finding_candidates.statement: For L=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} of degree 6 on a smooth genus-6 curve, Riemann–Roch χ(L)=1 proves only that the full Abel–Jacobi fibre in Sym^6 is nonempty; it does not prove that the reduced-support open, or the ordered Conf_6 incidence Z_ev, is nonempty on every geometric fibre.

strongest_attack: Strongest attack: treat H^0(ω⊗W^∨(Γ)) as only a Serre-dual proxy and deny that CE evaluation-rank-failure equals residual surjectivity failure of H^0(W)→W|Γ (wrong expected rank, scroll-level incomplete series, or a different Fitting complex could move support); secondarily, deny that fibrewise matching of geometric points upgrades to reduced substack equality over a general finite-type base, and press non-flatness of Sym→Pic for scheme structure under S_6 quotients. Outcome: does not refute the stated theorem. Packet/SRC-0004 identify the relevant obstruction with the split H^0 groups; with H^1(W)=0 the dual is exactly coker evaluation of W; negative/zero degree analysis is standard; reduced-only equality is the usual finite-type consequence of identical geometric points; the S_6 claim is the standard free configuration cover of the reduced-support open; RR nonemptiness is only for the full fibre, as stated. Residual risk is confined to nonreduced Fitting ideals, descent off a chosen splitting, and reduced-support nonemptiness—all explicitly out of scope.
theorem_statement: Let B be a finite-type complex base carrying a smooth family of genus-6 tetragonal covers together with an actual balanced Casnati–Ekedahl splitting F=O(4)⊕O(5). Put W_f=(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)⊗gamma^*O(-f))|_C and L=W_5⊗omega_{C/B}^{-1}. On the relative ordered configuration stack Conf_6(C/B), let Z_ev be the Casnati–Ekedahl evaluation-rank-failure locus, and let I be the Abel–Jacobi incidence locus O_C(p_1+⋯+p_6)≅L. Then (Z_ev)_red=I_red. Moreover, the quotient of I_red by S_6 is the reduced-support open of the relative Abel–Jacobi fibre Sym_B^6(C)×_{Pic^6(C/B),[L]}B, and the ordering map is a finite étale S_6-torsor. Every geometric fibre of the full Abel–Jacobi fibre is nonempty, although this theorem does not assert that its reduced-support open is nonempty.
